question: which radiological concepts can the FlexiCT-3D-VLM text space read on whole-CT windows, at the scan level (the official image embedding) and at the token level (each final-layer patch token's share of the embedding), before these concepts are used to name the SAE features of the w20_b16 production dictionaries
written_before_results: 2026-10-23; no whole-CT concept score, token score or proxy of this run had been computed when the vocabulary, proxies, tests and the usability rule were written

members.luna25: one nodule per patient: the profile members of campaign 20261014_sae_interpretation (1,264 train, 422 development patients), whose nodules have radiomics in run 20261017_sae_radiomics; the patient's scan is the scan of that nodule and its official w20 window is the window analysed; all train and development official windows are encoded for the later steps; the test partition is unused
members.lidc: one nodule per patient: the 582 members of run 20261019_sae_lidc with its discovery and confirmation halves (291 each); the member's scan gives the official window, and a moved window when the nodule lies within 24 mm of the official window border (the w20 rule)

template.source: official CT-RATE zero-shot evaluation (ct_rate_eval.py), class names lower-cased

text.embedding: Flexi_CT_VLM.encode_text (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B tower with the checkpoint's text projection, L2-normalised)
text.direction: for each concept, the mean over its phrasings of normalised(present) minus normalised(absent)
text.scan_score: inner product of the official image embedding normalise(W [CLS, mean patch]) with the concept direction; equals the mean over phrasings of cos(image, present) - cos(image, absent)
text.token_score: inner product of W_patch p_t with the concept direction, where W_patch is the last 864 columns of vlm_vision_projection.weight and p_t a final-layer patch token; the mean over the 8,000 tokens plus the class-token term gives the unnormalised scan score exactly

hiatal_hernia: herniation of the stomach through the esophageal hiatus

part_solid_nodule: subsolid nodule with a solid component

carpal_tunnel_syndrome: median nerve compression at the wrist

vocabulary.control_rule: conditions of body regions outside every chest CT window, with three phrasings each like the tested concepts; they estimate how far an unrelated text direction follows a proxy through the components that all present-minus-absent directions share

geometry.lung: on the official window (2.0 mm, HU clamped to [-1000, 1000]): voxels below -500 HU; in each axial plane, regions connected to the plane border (air outside the body, outside the reconstruction field and window padding) are removed; of the remaining 6-connected 3D components those of at least 0.2 of the largest one are kept (excludes bowel and stomach gas); in each axial plane, enclosed regions of at most 1,000 mm^2 are filled, so that vessels and nodules inside the lung belong to it while the mediastinum never does; the airways stay in the mask; a window whose lung volume is below 1.5 litres is marked as failed and leaves the lung-based tests
geometry.body: voxels above -500 HU opened with a 2-voxel ball (removes the table and other thin structures), largest 26-connected component, joined with the lung, axial hole filling
geometry.tokens: each final-layer token covers an 8^3 block (16 mm); per token: lung fraction, body fraction, lung-voxel fractions below -950 HU (LAA) and in [-600, -250] HU (HAA), native metal volume, token-centre physical position, signed distance to the analysed nodule and to every annotated nodule of the scan
geometry.far_lung_token: lung token whose centre lies more than 32 mm from the surface of every annotated nodule of the scan
geometry.nodule_tokens: tokens whose centre has a signed distance <= 4 mm to the analysed nodule surface, joined with the token whose block contains the nodule centre; a nodule whose centre block lies outside the window leaves the token-level tests
geometry.height: token-centre superior-inferior position within the lung, 0 at the lowest and 1 at the highest lung voxel of the window
geometry.medial: minus the left-right distance from the token centre to the midpoint of the lung's left-right extent (mm)
geometry.partial_lung_tokens: tokens with a lung fraction above 0
geometry.mediastinum_band: non-lung body tokens (lung fraction 0, body fraction >= 0.5) between the lowest and highest lung voxel
geometry.metal: native-resolution voxels >= 2500 HU whose in-plane 3x3 neighbourhood median is also >= 2500 HU (isolated noise spikes in bone of very noisy reconstructions fail it, thin clips on one slice pass), inside the window's physical extent, mapped to the token whose block contains them; volume in mm^3
geometry.noise: window image noise: 1.4826 x median absolute deviation of left-right neighbour differences between body voxels outside the lung in (-150, 150) HU, divided by sqrt(2)
geometry.metal_reference_token: body token without metal whose centre lies more than 32 mm from every metal token

proxies.log_max_volume: log of the largest annotated nodule volume of the scan (target component of each LUNA25 mask, native voxels) or, for LIDC, of the member's consensus volume
proxies.nodule_count: number of annotated nodules of the LUNA25 scan in the analysed partition
proxies.log_volume: member nodule: log nodule__shape_VoxelVolume (LUNA25 radiomics) or log consensus volume (LIDC)
proxies.lidc_calcification: fraction of readers rating any calcification
proxies.lidc_texture: median reader texture rating (1 = non-solid, 5 = solid)
proxies.pd15: 15th percentile HU of the window's lung voxels
proxies.haa: fraction of lung voxels in [-600, -250] HU
proxies.noise: window image noise (geometry.noise); low-dose noise lowers PD15 and moves lung voxels into the HAA range, so the two density tests are adjusted for it
proxies.token_laa: per lung token, fraction of its lung voxels below -950 HU
proxies.token_haa: per lung token, fraction of its lung voxels in [-600, -250] HU

scan.lidc_excluded: LIDC includes contrast-enhanced studies whose undiluted venous contrast exceeds 2500 HU; LUNA25 scans are non-contrast low-dose screening CTs

token.patients: windows with at least 100 mm^3 of metal
token.lidc_excluded: as for the scan-level metal test

statistics.scan_and_across: Spearman correlation over patients between the concept score and the proxy; with an adjustment, the partial Spearman correlation (ranks of score and proxy residualised on the rank of the adjustment variable, as in run 20261018_vlm_text_check)
statistics.contrast: per patient, (mean token score over target tokens - mean over reference tokens) / standard deviation over reference tokens; the statistic is the mean over patients
statistics.within: per patient, Spearman correlation between token score and token proxy over the stated tokens (at least 20); the statistic is the mean over patients
statistics.interval: 95% percentile interval from 2,000 bootstrap draws of patients, seed 20261023
statistics.control_bar: the largest absolute statistic of the eight control concepts on the same test and split

pass_rule: a test passes on a split when its statistic has the stated sign, its 95% interval excludes zero and its absolute value exceeds the control bar; it passes when it passes on both splits of its dataset
usability_rule: a concept is usable at a level (scan or token) when it has at least one test at that level and every one of its tests at that level passes; a concept without a test at a level is untested there

specific_variant.written: 2026-10-23 after the primary step 1 results: at the token level all eight controls showed large effects in the same direction (nodule contrast 0.2 to 1.3, medialness 0.28 to 0.51), so the token scores carry a component shared by every present-minus-absent direction
specific_variant.question: is there concept-specific information once that shared component is removed
specific_variant.rule: every scan score and token score is replaced by itself minus the mean of the eight control scores (direction d_c - mean control direction); the controls are treated the same way; the tests, intervals, bars and pass rule are unchanged
specific_variant.use: reported beside the primary analysis; the usable-concept table that steps 2 to 5 use stays the primary one

naming.written_before_results: 2026-10-23, while the step 0 materials were being computed; no step 1 or step 2 statistic existed
naming.features: stable features of the reference seed of trained_flexict_vlm_w20_b16_e4_k64: development_live and reappearance in at least 6 of the 7 other seeds (stability/<group>/features.npz)
naming.windows: the official window of each member patient (LUNA25 train for discovery, LUNA25 development for confirmation)
naming.write_vector: W_patch W_dec[f]: the direction feature f adds to the image embedding per unit activation (before normalisation); direction score D(f, c) = cosine with the concept direction

token_route.concepts: concepts usable at the token level in step 1
token_route.colocation: activation-weighted mean token score of concept c over the tokens where f is active, after removing f's own contribution (sum_t a_f(t) s_c(t) - g(f, c) sum_t a_f(t)^2, divided by sum_t a_f(t), with g(f, c) = scale <W_patch W_dec[f], d_c>), minus the mean token score over all tokens of the split's member windows, divided by the token-score standard deviation over those tokens
token_route.rule: D(f, c) is at least the 99th percentile of D over the dictionary's features active on train windows and exceeds D(f, k) for every control k; the colocation score is positive and exceeds the absolute colocation score of every control on train and on development; f is active in at least 30 windows of each split

scan_route.concepts: concepts usable at the scan level in step 1 and not at the token level
scan_route.association: Spearman correlation over patients between f's summed activation in the window and the scan score of c recomputed with f removed (the exact embedding after ablation, normalisation included)
scan_route.rule: the same direction condition as the token route; the association is positive and exceeds the absolute association of every control on train and on development; f is active in at least 30 windows of each split

naming.cross_seed: a reference feature keeps a name when, in at least 6 of the 7 other seeds, its matched feature (stability matching, decoder cosine >= 0.7) satisfies the same route's rule for the same concept
naming.causal_effect: reported for every named feature and concept: mean change of the scan score over train member windows where f is active when f is removed from every token (exact embedding recomputation), in units of the scan-score standard deviation over train patients
naming.unnamed: stable features without a name stay in the catalogue with their best direction score and colocation values

bridge.written_before_results: 2026-10-23, while the step 0 materials were being computed; no bridge statistic had been computed
bridge.features: stable reference-seed features of each field-site production group
bridge.records: LUNA25 profile members (one nodule per patient): train for discovery, development for confirmation
bridge.field_activation: maximum activation over the 216 field tokens (the classifiers read the maximum)
bridge.w20_activation: summed activation of each stable reference-seed w20_b16 feature over the record's 27 read tokens
bridge.bridge_route: the named w20 feature with the largest train Spearman correlation to the field feature; the bridge holds when that correlation is at least 0.5 on train and on development
bridge.direct_route: Spearman correlation between the field activation and the mean token score of a token-usable concept over the member's nodule tokens (step 1 nodule_mean); it holds for a concept when it is positive and exceeds the absolute correlation of every control concept on train and on development
bridge.rule: a field feature is named c when the bridge route gives a w20 feature named c and the direct route holds for c; otherwise it stays unnamed, with its best w20 match (named or not) and its correlations reported

contributions.written_before_results: 2026-10-23, while the step 0 materials were being computed; no classifier effect had been computed
contributions.heads: the seed-2025 heads used by the SAE campaign evaluation (head_run of evaluation/<production group>.json); best.pt copied from Mayo with equal SHA-256
contributions.tokens: w20_b16: the 27 read tokens of each record from its readout window, encoded in this run; f32_b10 and f40_b08: the 216 field tokens encoded in this run (stage fields)
contributions.check: head probabilities from these tokens reproduce the stored development predictions of the head run within 5e-3 (maximum absolute difference); the tokens are re-encoded on the local RTX 5070 Ti while the stored predictions come from the RTX 6000 Ada, and the first run with a 1e-3 limit stopped at w20_b16 with differences spread over all records (mean logit difference 0.0016, largest 0.016, equal for official and moved windows)
contributions.records: all LUNA25 development records (1,285 nodules); the test partition is unused
contributions.effect: for each record and each reference-seed feature active in its read tokens: head logit of the original tokens minus the logit after removing the feature's decoded contribution a_f(t) scale W_dec[f] from every token; the reconstruction error stays in the tokens
contributions.ranking: mean absolute effect over development records; the 50 largest are listed with stability, name and the Spearman correlation between their effect and log nodule volume over the records where they are active
contributions.groups: for each site, features are grouped into stable named, stable unnamed and unstable; the summed mean absolute effects are reported, and each group is removed jointly (all its features at once) to report the mean absolute logit change and the development AUROC
contributions.concept_model: w20_b16 only: ridge regression (penalty chosen by 5-fold cross-validation on train records) from the mean token score over the 27 read tokens of each token-usable concept to the head logit; development R^2 of concepts alone, of log nodule volume alone and of both

sae.stored: for each window and each of the eight production dictionaries: per-feature sum, sum of squares, active-token count and maximum of the activation, and the activation-weighted sum of every concept's token score; for the reference seed, the sparse token codes

encoding.check: on the first windows of each run the image embedding from the stored class and mean patch tokens equals Flexi_CT_VLM.encode_image within 1e-4, the concept token scores reproduce the unnormalised scan score, and the stored reference codes reproduce SpatialDictionary.encode
